position_applied.title: Job title as written on the resume, or inferred from context if not stated explicitly.
position_applied.level: Classify based on total years of experience (earliest job start to most recent job): <2 years = 'junior', 2-5 years = 'mid-level', >5 years = 'senior', manager/team-lead or above = 'leadership', insufficient data = 'unknown'. Values: junior | mid-level | senior | leadership | unknown

self_evaluation: Personal summary or career objective section verbatim. Empty string if not present.
skills_and_specialties: Skills, tools, technologies, and competencies extracted from the entire resume — including skills sections, work experience, projects, and education. Do not include languages. Extract all, omit none.

languages.proficiency: Proficiency level as written. Empty string if not stated.

certificates.name: Certificate name
certificates.score: Score as written. Empty string if not stated.
certificates.issuing_organization: Issuing organization as written. Empty string if not stated.
certificates.duration: Validity period as written. Empty string if not stated.

certifications.name: Professional certification name (exclude language certificates and academic degrees)
certifications.issuing_organization: Issuing organization as written. Empty string if not stated.
certifications.duration: Validity period as written. Empty string if not stated.

work_experience.company_description: Company size, industry, client type, etc. as written. Empty string if not stated.
work_experience.position: Job title at this company as written
work_experience.duration: Employment period (start month/year - end month/year) as written. Use the image to correctly match dates to each job in multi-column layouts.
work_experience.responsibilities: All duties, responsibilities, and achievements verbatim. Extract completely — do not summarize or omit. Use '- ' for main items, '+ ' for sub-items.

basic_information.location: Residence or hometown as written. Empty string if not stated.
basic_information.other_info: LinkedIn, website, Skype, GitHub, etc. as written. Empty string if not stated.

education_background.field_of_study: Field of study as written. Empty string if not stated.
education_background.graduation_year: Graduation year or status as written
education_background.gpa: GPA or classification as written. Empty string if not stated.

projects.description: Description, technologies, results, and role as written. Empty string if not stated.
projects.duration: Project period (start month/year - end month/year) as written. Empty string if not stated.
